name: lifequest
description: LifeQuest: convierte tus tareas diarias en un RPG. App web sin build, empaquetada como app Android con Capacitor.

scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/capacitor.js www/vendor/capacitor.js && mkdir -p www/vendor/firebase && for f in app auth firestore; do sed 's|//# sourceMappingURL=.*||' node_modules/firebase/firebase-$f-compat.js > www/vendor/firebase/firebase-$f-compat.js; done
scripts.android:sync: npm run vendor && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test:cloud: npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-lifequest 'node --test tests/cloud/*.test.js'
